label: ERROR_DEPENDENCE_2: assertions fail only through independent local coordinates
definition: IsolatedOnly κ G means κ G = 1: the shared condition holds almost surely, so assertions fail only through their own local coordinates, which the product profile makes independent and identically distributed. This is the stipulated-independence regime in which P(all true) = q^n.
